phases.title: Identity, access, and SQS foundations
phases.description: Establish safe access and learn the basic properties of a standard Amazon SQS queue.

phases.title: Standard-queue delivery behavior
phases.description: Practice receiving, deleting, delaying, retaining, and monitoring standard-queue messages.

phases.title: FIFO queues and delivery choices
phases.description: Learn when strict ordering and deduplication justify using FIFO queues.

phases.title: Failure handling and security
phases.description: Build resilient processing with retries, dead-letter queues, encryption, and authorization boundaries.

phases.title: Event-driven integrations
phases.description: Connect SQS to Lambda, SNS, S3, and EventBridge using common SAA-C03 patterns.

phases.title: Workers, monitoring, and scaling
phases.description: Use queue backlog signals to reason about EC2 workers, CloudWatch, and Auto Scaling.

phases.title: Architecture comparison and SAA-C03 scenarios
phases.description: Apply the learned services to realistic architecture-selection scenarios.

warnings.cost: Several planned integration labs can create billable resources, including AWS Lambda invocations, Amazon EC2 instances, CloudWatch alarms, KMS keys, and data-transfer or request charges. Review pricing and complete lab-specific cleanup after each detailed lab.
